name: split-attn-gated-nr
hypothesis: With the host latency hidden (split-attn-gated), a token is its GPU time, ~3,250 us at 64 tokens. The profile puts 47 mk_norm_add_norm launches a token at ~6 us each for a 2,048-word row: three passes that each wait on device memory, the second pass storing r and the third reading it back. Holding y, r and both weights in registers (same threads, words, expressions and reductions; mk_d2_norm_add_norm) should save ~1.5 us a launch: about -75 us a token, +2 to 2.5% decode at every length. Screen at 64: GPU 3,248 -> 3,170 us, wall 3,264 -> 3,185 us, two rounds.
